experiments.study_type: Viral gene delivery for chronic pain modulation
experiments.procedure_text: C57BL/6 mice received L4 DRG injection of AAV5-gfaABC1D-DBI-EGFP virions, with subsequent monitoring of mechanical and heat sensitivity to evaluate pain responses over 42 days.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: mechanical and heat sensitivity was monitored on the ipsilateral paws during 42 days after the DRG injection of AAV5-gfaABC1D-DBI-EGFP virions or GFP control virions
experiments.route_evidence: AAV virions were injected into the right-side L4 DRG

endpoints.label: Mechanical sensitivity (von Frey)
endpoints.evidence: Mechanical (von Frey; C) and heat (Hargreaves; D) sensitivity was monitored

endpoints.label: Heat sensitivity (Hargreaves)
endpoints.evidence: Mechanical (von Frey; C) and heat (Hargreaves; D) sensitivity was monitored

experiments.notes: The procedure involved focal delivery via DRG cannula/injection. Mechanical and heat sensitivity were assessed as endpoints.
